goal: the rules part of Pulp Cthulhu in the base (rules, archetypes, talents, occupations, skills, organizations, villains, monsters), linked to the core rules it changes (Р-183).
extra:
## This work (Р-183, Р-175, Р-177)

- The book is English: Russian text is our translation, flag `translated` (Р-21); the English name goes to `name.en`. Russian terms: use the base's existing records (skills `kb/skills`, characteristics, occupations `kb/occupations`, rules `kb/rules`) and the Russian Keeper Rulebook terms; new terms — translate plainly and keep the English in `aliases` or `name.en`. «Pulp» stays «пульп» (пульп-герой, пульп-талант).
- Every record of this book: `axes.ruleset: "pulp"`, `axes.era` — the book's era (1930s → use the axis values in common.schema.json; if no «1930s» value, use ["1920s"] and say «1930-е» in the text).
- Rules (`rule`, `kb/rules/pulp-<slug>.json`, id `coc:rule:pulp-<slug>`): one record per section, as in the Keeper Rulebook import (docs/conventions.md, Р-177): summary, text, steps, tables, examples, `optional: true` for «Pulp-O-Meter: Optional Rules» and other optional rules. A pulp rule that changes a core rule refers to it (`refs` → `coc:rule:<core slug>`, e.g. `coc:rule:spending-luck`, `coc:rule:wounds-and-healing`, `coc:rule:fighting-maneuvers`) and its `summary`/`text` says what it changes.
- Archetypes: `kind: archetype`, `kb/archetypes/<slug>.json`, id `coc:archetype:<slug>` — schema `schemas/archetype.schema.json`. Talents: `kind: talent`, `kb/talents/<slug>.json`, id `coc:talent:<slug>` — schema `schemas/talent.schema.json`.
- Pulp occupations: `coc:occupation:pulp-<slug>` (`kb/occupations/pulp-<slug>.json`), schema `schemas/occupation.schema.json`; if the base has the same occupation of the core (`kb/occupations/<slug>.json`), mention it in `description` (occupations have no `refs`).
- New skills (psychic skills etc.): `coc:skill:pulp-<slug>` (`kb/skills/pulp-<slug>.json`).
- Characters, creatures, organizations of the book: `kb/books/pulp-cthulhu-en/{characters,creatures,organizations}/<slug>.json`, ids `pulp-cthulhu-en/<kind>/<slug>` — models: `kb/books/masks-of-nyarlathotep-en/characters/*.json`, `kb/books/pobeg-iz-innsmuta-ru/organizations/*.json`. Statblocks as in the base (Р-25, Р-74). A villain's pulp talents — refs to `coc:talent:*` (list them in the report if another unit writes those talents).
- Table with a roll → `table` record `coc:table:pulp-<slug>` (Р-171).
- Links: only to records that exist in `kb/` or that your own unit creates; a talent or archetype another unit is writing at the same time — use the slug you are sure of (English name in lower case with hyphens, e.g. `coc:talent:hardened`) only if the brief of that unit is certain to create it; otherwise list it in the report.
- Text and every number from the page (the PDF has a text layer; check tables and numbers on the page image when the layout is complex).
- Coverage: `checks/20261108-pulp/<your unit name>.md` — every heading of your pages → the record that holds it, or «не взято» with the reason.
